request.query: Multiplying a nonzero polynomial by X to a natural power preserves monicity and adds that power to its degree

items.name: Polynomial.monic_X_pow_add_C
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} (a : R) [inst : Semiring R] {n : ℕ}, n ≠ 0 → (Polynomial.X ^ n + Polynomial.C a).Monic

items.name: Polynomial.natDegree_X_pow_mul
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] [Nontrivial R] {p : Polynomial R} (n : ℕ),
  p ≠ 0 → (Polynomial.X ^ n * p).natDegree = p.natDegree + n

items.name: Polynomial.natDegree_mul_X
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] [Nontrivial R] {p : Polynomial R},
  p ≠ 0 → (p * Polynomial.X).natDegree = p.natDegree + 1

items.name: Polynomial.monomial_mul_X
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (n : ℕ) (r : R),
  (Polynomial.monomial n) r * Polynomial.X = (Polynomial.monomial (n + 1)) r

items.name: Polynomial.Monic.natDegree_mul'
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {p q : Polynomial R}, p.Monic → q ≠ 0 → (p * q).natDegree = p.natDegree + q.natDegree

items.name: Polynomial.degree_lt_degree_mul_X
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {p : Polynomial R}, p ≠ 0 → p.degree < (p * Polynomial.X).degree

items.name: Polynomial.degree_mul_X
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] [Nontrivial R] {p : Polynomial R}, (p * Polynomial.X).degree = p.degree + 1

items.name: Polynomial.coeff_X_mul
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ), (Polynomial.X * p).coeff (n + 1) = p.coeff n
